lede: Some collaborations only need a press of play. B-POP Tags shares a performance by Special K and Omar Alkilani, with full credit to its creators.
body:
Some collaborations need no explanation, just a press of play, and Special K x Omar Alkilani is one of them. This post spotlights a performance created by **Special K** ([@specialk.music](https://www.instagram.com/specialk.music/)) and **Omar Alkilani** ([@omaralkilaniofficial](https://www.instagram.com/omaralkilaniofficial/)), produced by [@arkamag.co](https://www.instagram.com/arkamag.co/), [@arkacollective.co](https://www.instagram.com/arkacollective.co/) and [@hijazconvoy](https://www.instagram.com/hijazconvoy/).

## Special K x Omar Alkilani, produced by Arka

B-POP Tags is upfront about it: "all the credits go to the respective creators", and the cover carries a clear "Video courtesy: Arka Mag IG" line. The video still shows two musicians performing in a grand courtyard lined with arches and columns. One plays a keyboard setup fronted by a glowing "arka" sign, the other a stringed instrument, with smoke drifting across the floor and speakers set on a patterned rug. The Hijaz Convoy logo sits in the top corner.

## Where the tags point

The hashtags pair #popmusic and #arabmusic with #bangladeshi, #popculture and #arka, the same tag we used for our post on [Samaha Subah](post:samaha-subah-nakshi-kantha-art).

For more artists reaching beyond borders, read about [Halfcian of Salted Jus](post:halfcian-salted-jus-bangladesh-global-music), or dive into our [B-POP x IIZXXZII Spotify playlist](post:bpop-iizxxzii-spotify-playlist). There's more in [Music & Rave](topic:music) and on the [B-POP Tags home page](home:).

[See the original post on Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/p/DceRWkBknk1/)

faq.q: Who produced the Special K and Omar Alkilani performance?
faq.a: The post credits @arkamag.co, @arkacollective.co and @hijazconvoy as producers, with the video courtesy of Arka Mag's Instagram.
